lines: Adhva and here in seat was said that everywhere worship this; invocati
on-dismissal but there as before should perform.
l4.sanskrit_cite: adhvā cehāsane proktastatsarvatrārcayedidam āvāhanavisṛṣṭī tu tatra prāgvatsamācaret
